description: Create a subscription topic. Pass its id as topic_id when creating a broadcast to reach only the contacts subscribed to it. The default subscription is fixed at creation and cannot be changed afterwards, so confirm which one is wanted before calling this.

defaultSubscription.description: What a contact who has never expressed a preference receives. "opt_in" reaches everyone until they unsubscribe — right for a newsletter the list signed up for. "opt_out" reaches nobody until they explicitly join — right for anything a contact has to ask for, like a beta programme or a high-frequency digest. CANNOT be changed later.

description.description: Shown under the name on the unsubscribe page. At most 200 characters. Worth writing: it is what tells a recipient whether to keep the box ticked.

name.description: What the recipient reads on the unsubscribe page. At most 50 characters, and unique within the account.

visibility.description: Defaults to "private", which lists the topic on the unsubscribe page only to contacts already opted in. Use "public" only for a topic you are happy for anyone to discover — an internal campaign name shown to someone not on it invites them to opt out of something they were never getting.
